data.one_liner: View colored console logs with custom tags, file paths, and timestamps in Flutter.
data.what_it_does: Allows Flutter developers to output customized colored log messages to the console. It supports configuring visibility, tags, file paths, timestamps, and streaming log messages.
use_when: You want better-differentiated console logs with colors in Flutter
You need to easily toggle logs depending on debug or release modes
You want to stream or intercept log messages programmatically
avoid_when: You require advanced persistent crash reporting or remote log analytics services
strengths: Supports colored output and customized tags, file paths, and timestamps
Stream support allows listening to log records
weaknesses: Historic log printing feature was removed due to memory leak issues
Limited to console output and simple streaming
